processing: The user-supplied chorus MP3 is copied byte-for-byte without trimming, transcoding or seeking past its beginning. Playback starts and loops at zero. At the user's request, both previous Youjing recordings are removed from the project music directory; the-last-judgement.mp3 is retained unchanged. Deployment choices and campaign navigation preserve playback position using a chorus-specific navigation key, without inheriting the previous recording's offset; volume and battle-entry fade are applied at runtime.
